تعاطفت (form VI)
# تَعَاطَفْتُ (taʕāṭaftu) /ta.ʕaː.tˤaf.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَعَاطَفَ (taʕāṭafa)
# تَعَاطَفْتَ (taʕāṭafta) /ta.ʕaː.tˤaf.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَعَاطَفَ (taʕāṭafa)
# تَعَاطَفْتِ (taʕāṭafti) /ta.ʕaː.tˤaf.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَعَاطَفَ (taʕāṭafa)
# تَعَاطَفَتْ (taʕāṭafat) /ta.ʕaː.tˤa.fat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
